purpose: 复核同一请求在回滚前版本 2 下的真实允许结果。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive payments.audit --org acme --seq 3 --end-seq "$(cat payments.end-seq)" --fingerprint "$(cat payments.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 3
original decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["ledger-read"]
  policy version: 2
recomputed decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["ledger-read"]
  policy version: 2
consistent: yes

purpose: 复核空策略回滚产生的版本 3 默认拒绝；归档含后续重新授权，重算仍须使用版本 3。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive payments.audit --org acme --seq 5 --end-seq "$(cat payments.end-seq)" --fingerprint "$(cat payments.fingerprint)"
output:
target sequence: 5
original decision:
  allowed: false
  reason: "no matching allow policy"
  matched policies: []
  policy version: 3
recomputed decision:
  allowed: false
  reason: "no matching allow policy"
  matched policies: []
  policy version: 3
consistent: yes
